categories.fetchable: not in OPD; a verified fetch row from the parliament exists (adapters, Bern fetch, Curia Vista)
categories.image_only: in OPD without usable text (census image_only, or an adapter found the answer file in OPD without text: extract_tag); text_verified = text layer or OCR of OPD's own copy verified
categories.opd_elsewhere: in OPD with text, filed under an agenda item or without a parent (agenda join, Bern relink)
categories.open: not found yet: listed_unverified (Jura), review, adapter_failed, no_adapter
categories.oral: answered orally in the sitting (census link_status oral): no written text is expected
categories.unrecognised: in OPD with text on the affair, under a heading the census lexicon does not list (adapter tag_answer, counted tier)

listed_unverified.note: tier identity_wording_only: identity and wording match, no date check (OPD's Jura answer events carry no date); listed for a person or OPD to confirm, not counted

note: Derived layer over the registered census (census/corrected.py). The registered count stays: 'no answer text' = written-answer interventions without answer text attached in OPD (census gap). This layer places every gap row in one category from the repair results; adapter rows count only in the counted verification tiers (exact_date, date_window).

sentences.decomposition: Of the registered 16,749: 1,422 answered orally; 3,051 in OPD with text under an agenda item or without a parent; 2,316 in OPD with text under an unrecognised heading (2,060 exact date, 256 date window); 1,425 in OPD only as a copy without text (897 of them read and verified from OPD's own copy); 3,647 not in OPD but fetchable from the parliament (verified); 4,888 not found yet.
sentences.headline: The registered census counts 16,749 interventions with a written government answer but no answer text attached in OpenParlData; 2,316 of them are in OPD with text under a heading the census lexicon does not recognise, so at most 14,433 lack answer text on their affair in OPD.
sentences.jura: Listed, not counted: 282 Jura answers that match by identity and wording only (OPD's Jura answer events carry no date).
sentences.report: across 54 parliaments, 82.3% of written answers have their text in OPD (85.0% after the agenda join and the Bern relink; 92.5% after every counted repair, adding the answers OPD already holds under an unrecognised heading, the verified text of OPD's own image-only copies and the verified fetches from the parliaments)
sentences.written: Of these at most 14,433, 1,422 were answered orally in the sitting, so at most 13,011 written answers lack answer text on their affair in OPD.
sentences.y2425: For 2024–25 the registered count is 1,855 (367 oral); 158 are in OPD under an unrecognised heading, so at most 1,697 lack answer text on their affair in OPD and at most 1,330 written answers.

tier_labels.date_window: verified (date window <= N days, per parliament)
